subject.title: [Bug]: Codex app-server reply-session-init conflict leaves the session with no transcript mirror → tool-results silently return empty with no self-heal

question: Should #101920 be accepted as the canonical reply-session-init conflict recovery boundary for this issue, or should maintainers require a narrower recovery design before merge?
rationale: The bug is source-supported, but the fix crosses reply-session initialization, work-admission draining, MCP runtime teardown, and harness reset ownership, so maintainer intent is needed before closing the issue on the PR path.

options.title: Review and land the lifecycle self-heal
options.body: Treat #101920's shared reply-session recovery boundary as the canonical fix after fresh PR review and live proof.

options.title: Narrow the recovery boundary first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask the PR to reduce scope if maintainers want a more limited recovery path than runtime teardown plus harness reset.

options.title: Reject the shared self-heal
options.body: Keep the issue open for a different fix if maintainers prefer channel/runtime-specific retry paths despite the reporter's runtime-agnostic correction.

recommendation.title: Review and land the lifecycle self-heal
recommendation.body: Treat #101920's shared reply-session recovery boundary as the canonical fix after fresh PR review and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the reply-session serialization path where the current conflict branch lives, making them a strong owner for the recovery-boundary decision.
